environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has three listener rules evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 5: forward /health to target group unconditionally, (2) Priority 10: a rule with conditions path-pattern=/api/* that routes through an associated WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains a single rule group reference: a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' with capacity 700. This rule group has two rules: Rule A (priority 1) inspects QUERY_STRING with a RegexPatternSet containing patterns for common SQL metacharacters including the sequence "' OR", "UNION SELECT", "--", and "%27" with action BLOCK; Rule B (priority 2) uses a SizeConstraint on QUERY_STRING with max 128 bytes, action BLOCK. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress except to the VPC endpoint for CloudWatch Logs, enforced by the task's awsvpc security group (egress only to pl-xxxxx prefix list for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs on port 443).

config.load_balancer: ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association on ALB ARN

ecs_task_security_group.ingress: from ALB security group on port 8080
ecs_task_security_group.egress: only to VPC endpoint prefix list pl-02cd2c6b (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.logs) on port 443

config.network_note: No internet egress from task; DNS resolution via VPC .2 resolver only
